observations: owner identity uses the repository canonical TTG_AUTH /auth/me owner_admin + approved rule
Hunter owns only the persisted owner route-policy preference while Pete remains the policy evaluator
manual/approved paid model validation requires current Pete registry evidence when model-specific state is changed
local Pete MCP target remains exact loopback and bearer authenticated
cloud KV persistence and local mirror do not contain Pete MCP credentials
failed local runtime application is reported pending_reconciliation rather than falsely synchronized
cloud policy secret transport fails closed unless the configured online origin is clean HTTPS
cognitive bridge secret transport requires a clean HTTPS origin with no userinfo/path/query/fragment
Python and TypeScript maxFallbacks integer semantics match
Workers VPC permits exactly the two Phase 14 Pete admin routes in addition to the existing cognitive status/preflight/observe routes
the VPC proxy strips the browser Authorization header and forwards only the dedicated cognitive bridge secret plus bounded content headers
the dedicated Cognitive Bridge mounts the existing canonical Pete admin handlers through a non-listening staging registration adapter rather than duplicating policy logic
Pete invoke, Pete status and chat routes are not mounted on the dedicated Cognitive Bridge
the copied Pete admin handlers enforce HUNTER_COGNITIVE_BRIDGE_SECRET inside the handler itself, so omission of unrelated staging request hooks does not remove the admin secret boundary
bridge-specific runtime requirements include the existing requests dependency used by the Pete MCP client
policy validation failure remains a 400 client error while Hunter route-policy persistence failure is independently classified as 503 PETE_ROUTE_POLICY_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE

policy reads distinguish persisted, default_unset and unavailable instead of collapsing read failure into the default policy
owner snapshot reports ownerPolicy null and policyRuntimeSynchronized null when the policy store cannot be read, while preserving independently available Pete runtime state
the cognitive bridge policy-read endpoint returns 503 on policy-store read failure instead of supplying a fabricated default to reconciliation
